caption: The drawing depicts a structured object resembling the framework of a skirt or crinoline. It consists of a series of vertical beige bands or straps that extend from a circular waistband at the top, curving downward and outward to form a bell-shaped structure. These vertical straps are intersected and connected by numerous evenly spaced, thin, horizontal rings or bands, likely indicating metal hoops, rendered with fine, gray lines. The vertical bands feature a series of evenly distributed hooks or fasteners drawn in brown color, and there are small punched holes visible near the top of the waistband. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations. The drawing appears technical, with precise, measured lines and careful detailing of the components. The artist's signature, "E. Fortanier," is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Hoop Skirt
